name: InfiniBand Trade Association: What's new in Release 2.1, Volumes 1 and 2
notes: Release notes dated 2026-07-31: Volume 1 Release 2.1 (2294 pages) and Volume 2 Release 2.1 (835 pages). Volume 2 defines the physical layer electrical and optical interfaces at data rates up through XDR at 200 Gb/s per lane. New material includes updated XDR data rate support and CMIS 5.4 support.
